stem.en: A carbon-chlorine bond breaks such that each fragment keeps one of the two bonding electrons, producing two neutral species. What is this bond-breaking process called, and what are the resulting species?
stem.et: Süsinik-kloori side katkeb nii, et kumbki fragment hoiab üht kahest sidumiselektronist, tekitades kaks neutraalset osakest. Kuidas nimetatakse seda sidemekatkemise protsessi ja millised on tekkivad osakesed?

label.en: Homolytic cleavage, producing two neutral radicals, each with an unpaired electron
label.et: Homolüütiline katkemine, tekitades kaks neutraalset radikaali, kummalgi paardumata elektron

label.en: Heterolytic cleavage, producing a cation and an anion
label.et: Heterolüütiline katkemine, tekitades katiooni ja aniooni

label.en: Ionisation, producing two ions of opposite charge
Hydrolysis, producing an acid and a base
